receptor.title: Inactive human histamine H2 receptor with famotidine bound (cryo-EM, 3.0 A)

method.docking: AutoDock Vina 1.2.5, exhaustiveness 32, seed 42, 24.0 A cubic box, 20 poses; the reported pose is the best-scoring one whose centroid is within 5.0 A of the crystallographic famotidine
method.ligand_prep: RDKit ETKDGv3 embedding and MMFF optimisation, Meeko PDBQT
method.receptor_prep: chain A protein atoms, Open Babel PDBQT (rigid)
method.validation: famotidine redocked against its own crystallographic pose in 7UL3; the table reports both the top-ranked pose and the closest of the twenty poses returned
